summary: Round 2 re-validation: 6 of 7 round 1 findings fully resolved. Only one residual inconsistency: the Solution section (line 16, Phase B paragraph) still says 'drops 16 .block() sites' while Architecture (line 39) and Task 9 (line 427) now correctly say 17. Same load-bearing count is now both correct (twice) and stale (once) in the same document — a reviewer running the grep gate will see drift. Severity: minor (cosmetic internal inconsistency, no executability impact). New issues: none — re-verified BCrypt sites (4 in AuthService), .block() sites (17 active calls + 2 comments at lines 32/221), reactive mock-triple sites (6 files + 2 @WebFluxTest slice files = 8 test classes), extractIp declarations (3 controllers + AuthService = 4), one-way auth → security import direction (zero reverse imports), spring-session-data-mongodb 3.5.0 resolved (matches Boot 3.5.0), CsrfFilter.DEFAULT_CSRF_MATCHER is public static final in spring-security-web 6.5.0 (resolved version). All other previously-verified claims still hold.
